cc:Work.dc:title: Rail371 energy versus sparsity budget
cc:Work.dc:description: Three fixed-pattern energy curves read from the original rail371 energy text files. 371 DOFs, 122 aggregates, 915 candidates, all f=1, omega=0.5, absolute tolerance=1e-8. Exact score ties ordered by row then column.
